name: Libram of Constitution
label: Quest
description: Libram of Constitution: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is a price to pay for all things in this world. The price for the specific item that you seek is thirty gold pieces.
Naturally, I shall retain the majority of the components which you collected. But worry not, you shall have your trinket.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is disgrace to his memory... A mortal, such as yourself, finishing his life's work.
Take your amalgamation and be gone!
